session.summary: Built native Orca -> DSH worker launch (role 2) in examples/dsh-orca/: dsh-agent shim runs as the Orca terminal command, parses the JSON task payload from stdin, prepares an isolated DSH_HOME, launches headless DSH, and worker_done routes back to the Orca Run. Provider/model contract for opencode-go/gpt-5.6-luna was probed raw: it only terminates correctly on the OpenAI Responses API, and DSH pi-ai currently selects api at ProviderSpec level, so Luna is marked BLOCKED with GMI as the operational fallback.

No fake provider names: opencode-go-responses was tried, produced NO_ADAPTER, and was reverted. Provider identity != API protocol.

Failure classifier: quota/429/404/unauthorized/not-supported AND transport failures (stream ended, finish_reason, transport) are fallback-eligible. NO_ADAPTER / local config errors are NOT fallback-eligible.
Orca adapter must not own the model catalog; catalog values must come from the provider (models.json / GET /v1/models), never invented.
Credential boundary: never read ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml or ~/.flinter/gmi-env.sh; dsh-agent sources gmi-env.sh without reading it.
Scope: flinter/dsh-orca-plugin branch, examples/dsh-orca/ only. AWS role 3 (flinter/dsh-segment) must stay unaffected.
